anomalies.description: A large, sudden explosion with fireball and dense smoke erupts, throwing debris and obscuring the scene; people are visible near the blast zone.

After the explosion, armed personnel in riot gear (helmets, shields, uniforms) are seen standing in formation amid smoke and debris; banners with Chinese characters suggest a protest context, and the scene shows collective violent unrest with casualties.

A person lies motionless on the ground with severe head trauma and blood, while others (including uniformed personnel) stand nearby without intervention; the presence of a sign near the body and the chaotic aftermath suggest the victim is helpless and has been subjected to violence.

A sudden bright flash and expanding white smoke/cloud erupts behind the female character in frame f14–f15, consistent with a small explosive device detonating (e.g., a flashbang or grenade). The rapid onset and volumetric expansion distinguish it from sustained fire or smoke deployment.
Two individuals are engaged in a physical altercation in the background, with one appearing to strike or grapple the other; motion blur suggests rapid movement consistent with fighting.
